name: @cms/adapter-sdk
description: Frozen invariant-bearing public contract for the handoff CMS adapter surface. Defines canonical_source / derived_artifacts / regeneration_contract (alias_symlink) as the frozen core, capability discovery, activation / reconciliation / apply boundaries, canonical-only write intent, and provisional 1.0-beta/RC host-specific extensions (field_capabilities, DeployCapability). Adapters that touch a host repository implement this contract; the system owns governed projection only.
